name: Veiled Moon Warp (Combat)
body:
Your strikes can force an enemy into the aether for a short time.

Prerequisites: Veiled Moon Style, Veiled Moon Shunt, Stealth 15 ranks.

Benefit: As a standard action, you may expend one of your readied strikes and make a melee attack against an opponent. If it hits, deal weapon damage as normal and the target must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest initiation modifier) or become incorporeal for one round. The target can no longer grasp their weapons (unless they could be wielded by incorporeal creatures) but their other equipment remains on their body without becoming incorporeal, effectively rendering them incapable of using any items that do not have the ghost touch property or an equivalent effect. This is a supernatural ability.
